title: Predicting Hospitalization Costs
description: Python pipeline to predict hospitalization costs across three stages (admission, post-admission, discharge) and newborn/non-newborn cohorts; aims to provide insights into cost drivers and improve resource allocation.

title: SLP Helper
description: SLP Helper is a web application designed to help medical SLPs (speech-language pathologists) generate therapy orders and calculate their daily productivity. It aims to streamline the documentation process and enhance the clinician's efficiency.

title: Spotify Analytics Dashboard
description: This interactive dashboard visually explores Spotify audio trends and artist comparisons, enabling insights into optimal release timing and promotion strategies via a storytelling user experience.

title: Interactive Bike Visualization
description: The visualization highlights peak bicycle rental usage times and popular routes, providing insights into urban mobility.

title: Interactive Visualization: Global GDP Trends
description: This interactive visualization intends to compare the GDP per capita across different countries from years 1960–2020. It highlights the economic growth patterns, major events such as the 2008 global recession, and country-specific events as well such as Rwandan Genocide.

title: Deceptive Visualization, Dual Stories: NYPD Bias vs Fairness
description: Seeking to tell opposing stories with the same dataset.  focusing on the number of reports can tell one story, while focusing on the composition can tell another.

title: Ethical Considerations in Machine Learning for Skincare Recommendation
description: Ethical considerations at each stage of development for a skincare recommendation machine learning system.
